results.description:
Scattered elder care information everywhere? Elderella is one secure place for everything about your parent, spouse, or aging relative's care.

If you've been searching for a family caregiving app that actually helps, this is it. Ella turns your conversations, notes, and documents into a plan you and your care team can act on.

HOW ELDERELLA HELPS

* Builds and activates your care team of family, friends, and professionals and keeps them in the loop so you don't have to repeat yourself. Chat with them right in Elderella, one-on-one or as a group, and Ella picks up the care details. You choose what each person can see.

* Collects elder care details automatically from everywhere and everyone (chats in Elderella, your family's group chat, calendars, phone calls, appointment recordings, voice notes, photos, emails, and documents).

* Answers anyone on your care team instantly from your care memory, showing each person only what they're allowed to see, and flags what needs attention.

* Records and transcribes calls to your elder's dedicated phone number, so the care team never misses what was said. Share the number with doctors, pharmacies, and anyone else who calls with important information.

* Records appointments so you don't have to take notes. Ella adds any new instructions, tasks, and events from what was said.

* Snap the hospital discharge instructions, and Ella adds the follow-up appointments, medications, and tasks.

* Keeps every prescription, supplement, and vaccine on one list.

* Tracks anything you want to keep an eye on, like headaches, sleep, or how often someone visits. Tell Ella in your own words, and the tracker shows the pattern over time.

* Gets you started and shows what's been handled and what still needs to be done. Pin what you use most so it's one tap away.

* No signal in the waiting room? Elderella still opens to what you last saw on your phone, and the details you add sync once you're back online.

USER TESTIMONIALS

"What Ella actually lifts is the cognitive load that was quietly breaking me. My one real regret is not bringing it into the loop earlier. My siblings are experiencing all of this remotely, and the tension that builds inside families during caregiving is very real. I think we'd be on better terms now if Ella had been part of the picture from the start." - Sherryl T.

"Elderella has been a tremendous support in helping organize care responsibilities, improve communication, and reduce the mental load that comes with managing so many moving pieces." - Suzanne H.

"Helps me keep track of the ever-changing list of meds prescribed to my father, as well as appointments with health professionals and their contact info. And I can share this with others on our care team." - Debbie C.

WHAT SETS US APART

Built by family caregivers, and informed by family doctors, geriatricians & frail elder physicians, nurses, estate planners, lawyers, bankers, caregiver organizations, and elder care advocates.

100% ad-free forever.

FREE TRIAL

Start your 7-day trial of Elderella Plus with full elder care features including appointment recording, call protection with a dedicated phone number, 10 care team members, and unlimited care memory.

Free plan includes: the care map, medication & vaccine tracking, care team chats, custom trackers, calendar sync, 5-minute voice notes, 3 care team members, and 90-day care memory.

PRIVACY

Your family's information is encrypted, never sold, and you decide who sees what. Designed to align with PIPEDA (Canada) and HIPAA (US) standards. Delete your information at any time.

Elderella does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or emergency services. Always consult qualified professionals for medical decisions or urgent concerns.

Terms of Use: https://www.elderella.com/terms

results.description:
ianacare is for family caregivers: anyone caring for a parent, spouse, child, or other loved one living with a chronic or serious illness, including dementia.

Caring for someone you love isn't the problem — it's figuring out the unknowns. ianacare helps you get answers, make a plan, and keep track of it all, with real human support behind every step for eligible programs.

Anyone can access iana, Action Plans, the care log, and family coordination, on your phone or computer. If ianacare comes through your employer or the Medicare GUIDE program, you may also have a Care Navigator and additional resources (see below).

CHAT WITH IANA™, YOUR AI CARE COMPANION
Caregiving doesn't have office hours. Ask iana about managing care around a new diagnosis, a difficult behavior, or what to ask the doctor tomorrow, and iana can help you think it through. iana is built on ianacare's I Am Not Alone Care Model, shaped by 50,000+ family journeys, and remembers your situation so you don't have to start over.

KNOW WHAT TO DO NEXT
Answer a few questions about where things stand today, and iana builds your Action Plan: a personalized, prioritized list of next steps with vetted resources and support options. It updates as your situation changes, so it's never a generic checklist.

KEEP TRACK OF THE DAY-TO-DAY
Quick Log captures care notes in a few taps — in the waiting room, the parking lot, or the kitchen at 6 a.m. Care Log History keeps every note and iana chat in one searchable place, and iana can summarize it before an appointment so you walk in prepared.

BRING IN FAMILY & FRIENDS, IF YOU WANT TO
Caring on your own? Everything above works for you. If others want to help, invite them to coordinate meals, rides, and tasks without the group text.

THROUGH YOUR EMPLOYER
If ianacare is a benefit at your work, you also get a Care Navigator, a trained caregiving expert you can message or schedule a call with. You'll also find benefits your employer offers, live events and support groups, and practical articles on the Community Hub. 

THROUGH THE MEDICARE GUIDE PROGRAM
The Medicare GUIDE program supports people living with dementia and the family members who care for them. If ianacare is your GUIDE provider, you may also have a dedicated Care Navigator, dementia-specific support, help arranging rest breaks (respite care), live events and support groups, and the Community Hub. If your Care Navigator is through another GUIDE provider, ianacare adds iana, tailored resources, and live events alongside that support. 

PRIVATE AND SECURE
ianacare follows HIPAA standards to protect your health information, and your data is encrypted to keep it safe. Your information is never sold or used for advertising, and you choose who on your team can see it.

IMPORTANT
iana is an AI, not a substitute for professional medical or mental health advice. Always talk with your care team about medical decisions. In a medical emergency, call 911. If you're in crisis, call or text 988.

Terms of Use: https://ianacare.com/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: https://ianacare.com/privacy-policy/

results.description:
Life and healthcare, finally on the same page.

HomeTeams brings family, friends, neighbors and care professionals into one shared space, so everyone knows what's happening and how to help.

You've been carrying a lot, and you don't have to carry it alone. Caring for a parent, supporting a child, managing a health condition — wanting help isn't weakness. It's human. Even the best teams need a game plan and people who show up.

Caregivers who go it alone average 22.8 hours of care work a week (AARP & NAC, 2025). With a HomeTeam, that load is spread across many hands.

BUILT FOR REAL LIFE

Caring for aging parents. Managing a chronic condition. Recovery and post-hospital support. Family scheduling and everyday household coordination.

YOUR HEALTH RECORDS, PULLED IN FOR YOU

Verify your identity once and HomeTeams gathers your medical records for you — hospital stays, the urgent care visit you forgot about, labs, clinical notes and medications, from the places you've been treated. New records keep arriving as care happens, so the picture stays current. Ask Coach to explain any of it in plain English.

Add your own notes and documents, and choose which teammates see what. Connect Apple Health for steps, sleep and weekly activity trends. Keep insurance cards and forms in the Resource library. When you need a real person, reach a nurse from the Health tab, day or night.

SET UP IN MINUTES

Answer four questions out loud and Coach builds your team, or type them if you'd rather. Name the team, add the first appointment, send invites.

ONE SHARED PLAN

Team Home is the feed everyone sees: what happened today, what's coming up, who has it covered. As Team Captain you decide what each teammate can see, and can switch teams if you support more than one household.

TASKS THAT ACTUALLY GET DONE

Create a task — we call them actions — for errands, appointments, rides, meals, medications or quality time. Choose who it's for and who does it, set a date or leave it open, and sort with color-coded categories. Filter by category, status or day, or see the week at a glance. When a task looks like a medication, HomeTeams sets it up with dose, strength and reminder times.

COACH, YOUR MENTOR AND GUIDE

Coach is the AI at the heart of HomeTeams. It answers the question in front of you at 11pm, in plain words — Coach knows the plan, the medications, and who to pull in. Ask by voice or text, open the daily digest to see what changed, and let Coach turn guidance into steps your team can pick up.

HOMETEAMS WALLET

Care costs money and it rarely falls evenly. Link a card you already use and cash back accumulates passively at participating merchants, tagged to your team's goal. Relatives can contribute directly to shared Team Funds. Real cash, not points, not coupons — with a clear view of who has given what.

BRAE PROGRAMS

Structured mind, body and soul health plans: living with a chronic condition, building the mental toughness caregiving demands, or working through forgiveness. Short daily practices, gentle accountability, and a team that shows up with you.

LIVING LEGACY

Some things should outlast the calendar. Living Legacy captures a life story in the person's own voice, one gentle question at a time, with Coach guiding. Old photos are restored and kept in a private family vault.

STAY CONNECTED

Message the whole team, a small group, or one person, without endless group texts. Notifications separate what needs attention from what's handled.

Most apps help one person stay organized. HomeTeams helps people show up for each other, and turns caring into coordinated action.

Build your team. Care together.

HomeTeams is not a healthcare provider or a medical device, and does not diagnose, treat or prevent any condition. Coach and the nurse line provide general information only and are not a substitute for care from your own clinician. HomeTeams does not provide emergency services. In an emergency, call your local emergency number.

CaringBridge is a no-cost, 501(c)(3) nonprofit health platform that surrounds family caregivers with support while they care for a loved one on a health journey. A donor-supported nonprofit founded in 1997, the organization offers tools to share and document a health journey, simplify care coordination, and connect caregivers with a supportive community. Somehow you became the one who keeps track of it all — the pills, the appointments, who said they'd stop by. When a parent is getting older, a partner is in treatment, or someone you love needs care every day, it almost always lands on one person: you.

CircleCare shares the load. Create one care circle around the person you care for, invite the people who help, and everyone works from the same up-to-date picture, whether they live down the street or across the country.

EVERYONE ON THE SAME PAGE
- Medications, appointments, tasks and notes in one shared place
- See who did what: who gave a dose, who finished a task, who left a note
- The activity feed shows every update from everyone in the circle, so nobody has to ask "did anyone check?"
- With reminders on, if a dose isn't marked in time, the alert goes to the person taking it, then to the caregivers, then to the whole circle

MEDICATIONS, SHARED
- Daily, weekly or custom schedules, with reminders
- Mark a dose taken or skipped, and the whole circle sees it
- New: as-needed medications. Log a dose when it's given, like a pain reliever, and everyone can see when the last one was given and by whom

APPOINTMENTS AND TASKS
- One shared calendar for doctor visits, treatments and tests
- Assign tasks and appointments to someone, or leave them open for whoever can help
- Add notes and questions so the next person knows what happened

NEW: THE DAILY UPDATE
Each evening at 7 pm, the Home screen shows a short summary of what the circle logged that day. If something was logged, you get one quiet notification, with no health details in it. It's free, and you can turn it off.

HEALTH INFO WHEN IT MATTERS
Allergies, conditions, doctors, insurance and emergency contacts in one place, ready to share as text or a PDF. Keep documents like test results and insurance cards with the circle too.

FREE TO START, FAIR AS YOUR TEAM GROWS
Free: 1 care circle for you + 1 caregiver. The person you care for can join too and doesn't count toward that. Medications and reminders are free forever. No credit card needed.

Premium, for families with more helping hands:
- Unlimited family members: everyone who helps, in one circle
- Add by voice: say a medication, task or appointment and we fill in the form for you to check. On supported phones.
- Adherence reports to share with doctors, plus calendar import
- 1 GB of documents per circle
- AI care assistant
- Up to 5 care circles

Monthly or yearly, priced fairly for your country. Yearly includes a free trial. Only the person who creates the circle pays. Invited family members never pay.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
This is your family's health information, not ad data. No ads. We never sell your data. Only the people you invite can see your circle.

IN 8 LANGUAGES
English, Spanish, French, French (Canada), German, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil) and Portuguese (Portugal). Everyone chooses their own.

GET STARTED IN A FEW MINUTES
Create a care circle, add a medication or an appointment, and invite your family. Nobody should have to carry this alone.
